name: Balancer Protocol
fix_description: In swapExactAmountIn(), do not trust the user-supplied tokenAmountIn for balance bookkeeping. Instead, measure the actual token balance change (balanceOf after - balanceOf before the transfer) to correctly handle deflationary/fee-on-transfer tokens that burn a portion during transfer.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires deep Balancer-specific knowledge of boosted pools, virtualSupply/rate cache mechanics, and a precision-loss edge case, then chains multiple carefully sized swaps across several pools to manipulate pricing and extract value. The PoC is multi-stage and highly protocol-specific, with non-obvious state interactions and exact amount tuning that would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours to derive from code alone.
